biggest_catch: The $400 requires direct deposits totaling $1,000+ within a SINGLE statement cycle (not spread across months), and the offer is restricted to residents of eligible zip codes inside a fixed county list in only three states: New York, Ohio, and Pennsylvania.
catches: Open a Northwest Affinity, Affinity Plus, or Affinity Premier Checking account by 12/31/2026 using the promo code (GET400 on the /get-400/ page, EARN400 on the /earn-400/ page); the promo code must be entered at account opening.
Make direct deposits totaling $1,000 or more within a single statement cycle, at any point within the first 3 statement cycles from account opening.
Qualifying direct deposit = an ACH credit, which may include payroll, pension, or government payments such as Social Security.
Account can be opened online or by bringing the offer email with the promo code to a financial center.
Bonus typically deposited within 30 days after the statement cycle in which you satisfy the requirement(s); the checking account must be open at payout.
Not available to existing Northwest checking account customers or those who closed a Northwest checking account in the last 12 months.

Offer limited to residents of eligible zip codes within: NY — Allegany, Cattaraugus, Chautauqua, Erie, Genesee, Niagara, Orleans, Wyoming counties; OH — Delaware, Fairfield, Franklin, Knox, Licking, Madison, Morrow, Pickaway counties; PA — Allegheny, Armstrong, Beaver, Butler, Carbon, Columbia, Crawford, Erie, Fayette, Lackawanna, Luzerne, Monroe, Sullivan, Warren, Washington, Westmoreland, Wyoming counties (per the official /earn-400/ page).

Affinity Plus Checking has a $15 monthly service charge (waivable with $5,000 average daily balance or $15,000 deposit/investment relationship); Affinity Premier Checking has a $25 monthly service charge (waivable with $15,000 average daily balance or $50,000 relationship). Base Affinity Checking has no monthly service charge or minimum balance.

Northwest Bank limits each customer to one new account-related bonus per calendar year; employees of Northwest Bank and its affiliates/subsidiaries are not eligible; cannot be combined with any other offer.
Bonus reported on IRS 1099-INT (or 1042-S without SSN/ITIN); offer subject to change or cancellation at any time without notice.
